insights.concise_text: The two popular football clubs that constitute the targets of the Turkish tweet data set are Galatasaray (Target-1) and Fenerbahçe (Target-2).

triple.object: Galatasaray (Target-1) and Fenerbahçe (Target-2)

insights.concise_text: The first study to target stance detection in Turkish tweets provides a publicly available stance-annotated data set of 700 tweets.

triple.subject: the current study
triple.object: a publicly available stance-annotated data set of 700 tweets

insights.concise_text: The baseline SVM classifiers trained with unigrams on the 700-tweet data set were evaluated with 10-fold cross-validation using precision, recall, and F-Measure.

triple.subject: baseline SVM classifiers trained with unigrams on the 700-tweet data set
triple.object: 10-fold cross-validation using precision, recall, and F-Measure

insights.concise_text: The SVM classifiers trained with unigrams on the 700-tweet data set produced quite favorable evaluation results for both targets, particularly higher for Target-1.

triple.subject: SVM classifiers trained with unigrams on the 700-tweet data set
triple.object: quite favorable evaluation results for both targets, particularly higher for Target-1

insights.concise_text: The data set used for the SVM experiments contains only Favor and Against classes because tweets with the Neither class were not annotated.

triple.subject: the data set used for the SVM experiments
triple.object: only Favor and Against classes

insights.concise_text: The 700-tweet data set is balanced with 175 Favor and 175 Against tweets for each of Galatasaray (Target-1) and Fenerbahçe (Target-2).

triple.subject: the 700-tweet data set
triple.object: Galatasaray (Target-1) and Fenerbahçe (Target-2) with 175 Favor and 175 Against tweets each

insights.concise_text: Adding the existence of hashtags to unigrams increased overall F-Measure for Target-2 by 1.8% but decreased F-Measure for Target-1 by 0.5%.

triple.subject: the existence of hashtags as an additional feature to unigrams
triple.object: a 1.8% overall F-Measure increase for Target-2 and a 0.5% F-Measure decrease for Target-1

insights.concise_text: The relatively limited size of the 700-tweet data set is offered as a possible reason why bigrams as sole SVM features led to quite poor results.

triple.subject: the relatively limited size of the 700-tweet data set
triple.object: SVM classifiers using bigrams as sole features

insights.concise_text: The paper's stated SVM classifiers using unigram, bigram, and hashtag features correspond to separate experiments with unigrams, bigrams, and unigrams plus hashtags.

triple.subject: SVM classifiers using unigram, bigram, and hashtag features
triple.object: separate experiments with unigrams, bigrams, and unigrams plus hashtags

insights.concise_text: The 10-fold cross-validation results presented as reference results by prospective systems are the evaluation results of the SVM classifiers on the 700-tweet data set.
